title: High DKK3 expression related to immunosuppression was associated with poor prognosis in glioblastoma: machine learning approach.
authors: Han, Myung-Hoon; Min, Kyueng-Whan; Noh, Yung-Kyun; Kim, Jae Min; Cheong, Jin Hwan; Ryu, Je Il; Won, Yu Deok; Koh, Seong-Ho; Myung, Jae Kyung; Park, Ji Young; Kwon, Mi Jung
one_liner_zh: 该研究利用机器学习分析GBM中DKK3表达与免疫抑制及预后的关联，属于肿瘤表达与临床预后研究，无蛋白质-DNA互作体系、结合建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Glioblastoma multiforme (GBM) is an aggressive malignant primary brain tumor. Wnt/beta-catenin is known to be related to GBM stemness. Cancer stem cells induce immunosuppressive and treatment resistance in GBM. We hypothesized that Wnt/beta-catenin-related genes with immunosuppression could be related to the prognosis in patients with GBM. METHODS: We obtained the clinicopathological data of 525 patients with GBM from the brain cancer gene database. The fraction of tumor-infiltrating immune cells was evaluated using in silico flow cytometry. Among gene sets of Wnt/beta-catenin pathway, Dickkopf-3 (DKK3) gene related to the immunosuppressive response was found using machine learning. We performed gene set enrichment analysis (GSEA), network-based analysis, survival analysis and in vitro drug screening assays based on Dickkopf-3 (DKK3) expression. RESULTS: In analyses of 31 genes related to Wnt/beta-catenin signaling, high DKK3 expression was negatively correlated with increased antitumoral immunity, especially CD8 + and CD4 + T cells, in patients with GBM. High DKK3 expression was correlated with poor survival and disease progression in patients with GBM. In pathway-based network analysis, DKK3 was directly linked to the THY1 gene, a tumor suppressor gene. Through in vitro drug screening, we identified navitoclax as an agent with potent activity against GBM cell lines with high DKK3 expression. CONCLUSIONS: These results suggest that high DKK3 expression could be a therapeutic target in GBM. The results of the present study could contribute to the design of future experimental research and drug development programs for GBM.
abstract_zh: 背景：多形性胶质母细胞瘤（GBM）是一种侵袭性恶性原发性脑肿瘤。已知Wnt/β-catenin信号通路与GBM的干性相关。癌症干细胞在GBM中诱导免疫抑制和治疗抵抗。我们假设与免疫抑制相关的Wnt/β-catenin相关基因可能与GBM患者的预后有关。方法：我们从脑癌基因数据库中获取了525例GBM患者的临床病理数据。使用计算机模拟流式细胞术评估肿瘤浸润免疫细胞的比例。在Wnt/β-catenin通路基因集中，通过机器学习发现了与免疫抑制反应相关的Dickkopf-3（DKK3）基因。我们基于Dickkopf-3（DKK3）表达进行了基因集富集分析（GSEA）、基于网络的分析、生存分析以及体外药物筛选实验。结果：在与Wnt/β-catenin信号相关的31个基因分析中，高DKK3表达与GBM患者抗肿瘤免疫增强呈负相关，尤其是CD8+和CD4+ T细胞。高DKK3表达与GBM患者的不良生存和疾病进展相关。在基于通路的网络分析中，DKK3直接与肿瘤抑制基因THY1相连。通过体外药物筛选，我们确定了navitoclax作为对高DKK3表达的GBM细胞系具有强效活性的药物。结论：这些结果表明，高DKK3表达可能成为GBM的治疗靶点。本研究结果可能有助于未来GBM实验研究和药物开发项目的设计。
